applies_to.quote: Reserve Bank of India (Urban Co-operative Banks – Concentration Risk Management) – Amendment Directions, 2026

answer.action: Ensure compliance with revised unsecured advance limits, nominal member loan rules, and manage non-compliant existing loans through run-off.
answer.action_quote: The aggregate unsecured loans and advances granted by a UCB shall not exceed 20 per cent of its total loans and advances

effective_date.quote: The above amendments shall come into force from October 1, 2026, or an earlier date when adopted by a UCB in entirety.

answer.amends: Reserve Bank of India (Urban Co-operative Banks – Concentration Risk Management) Directions, 2025
